rationale: 2022 AP Offensive Player of the Year and first-team All-Pro (2022, 2024), but no MVP or title, so 4 not 5. LSU is a known fact but not his defining story.

No. 1 pick, Comeback Player of the Year (2021, 2024), multiple Pro Bowls. His 2019 Heisman and national title at LSU define his story. Transferred from Ohio State (backup, 2015-2017) to LSU (starter, 2018-2019); LSU is the answer.
2021 Offensive Player of the Year, Super Bowl LVI MVP, receiving triple crown. Eastern Washington is a known biographical fact (Walter Payton Award, 2015) but rarely central to coverage of him.

No. 2 pick, 2017 Bert Bell Award and second-team All-Pro, Super Bowl LII ring as an injured starter, then several teams. Recognizable long-time starter rather than a sustained national star. North Dakota State is a known fact about him.
